やった！ 一番でっかいボスっぽいの、やっつけたよ！: We did it! We beat the biggest, boss-like one!
増援の勢いも弱まった！\nこのまま残存勢力を掃討、突破してサイレンの破壊を試みる: The momentum of their reinforcements has weakened, too! We will mop up the remaining forces, break through, and attempt to destroy Siren!!
（まさか……あの状況からひっくり返すなんてね）: (I can't believe... they actually turned it around from that situation.)
（なかなか面白い子ね、ドロテア・カークランド。\nそして隣のメイドも……）: (Quite an interesting girl, Dorothea Kirkland. And that maid next to her, too...)
（これも少なからず、あの男の影響もあるのかしら……\nほんと、変なやつ）: (I wonder if this is also due in no small part to that man's influence... Really, what a strange guy.)
……ここまでね。今日のところは退いてあげる。: ...This is as far as we go. We'll pull back for today.
全機、撤退開始！\nサイレンを回収したら、さっさと消えるわよ。: All units, initiate retreat! Once we recover Siren, we're vanishing out of here.
こちらが到達しないうちに、\n双頭の斧はサイレンを抱えてコトハを先頭に撤退を開始: Before we could reach them, the Double-Headed Axe secured Siren and began their retreat, led by Kotoha.
（くっ……相手の撤退のほうが、さすがに速いか……！）: (Ngh... Their retreat is faster than expected...!)
コトハ達は、メイズのさらなる深層へと消えていくのだった――: Kotoha and her squad vanished into the deeper layers of the Maze—
その後、あの『サイレン』という装置を解除したからだろうか。\n気が付けば増援は完: Afterwards, perhaps because that 'Siren' device had been deactivated, the reinforcements completely ceased before we knew it.
残るメイズシフターもサイレンによる誘導が解けたのか、こちらを\n見るなり散り散り: With Siren's guidance broken, the remaining Maze Shifters scattered and fled the moment they saw us, leaving only us behind.
こ、これって……わたし達の勝利、\nということでいいんでしょうか……？: D-Does this mean... we can consider this our victory...?
目標は人工スタンピード誘発装置――サイレンの破壊ないし停止だ。\nそれを達成した: Our goal was the destruction or deactivation of Siren, the artificial stampede inducer. Since we achieved that... we can certainly call it a victory.
できればサイレンは破壊までしたかったが、\nここまでやれれば上出来とするしかない: Ideally, I would have liked to completely destroy Siren, but given how far we came, we can only consider this a great success.
や……やったぁ……！\nボク達、最強だね！！: Y... Yay...! We really are the strongest!!
ただ……もう燃料も弾薬も尽きかけています。\n特に燃料は、ここでアイドリングして: However... our fuel and ammunition are nearly exhausted. Especially the fuel—even the time we spend idling here is precious.
そうですね。早々に撤退を開始しましょう。: Indeed. Let us begin our retreat immediately.
ええ。皆さん、本当によく戦ってくれました。\nどうか、ご無事で。: Yes. Everyone, you all fought exceptionally well. Please, return safely.
あたしとお嬢は、ちょっとばかり派手に動いたせいで\nたぶんみんなより燃料の残量が: Because Milady and I moved around a bit too flashily, our remaining fuel is probably lower than everyone else's.
地上までもちそうにはないな。\nあたしらのことは置いてけ。: It doesn't look like it'll last until the surface. Leave us behind.
そんな……それはだめです！\nリーダーを置いていくなんて！: No way... We can't do that! Leaving our leader behind is out of the question!
せっかくメイズシフターを退けたんだもん。\nみんなで帰らなきゃだよ！: We finally managed to repel the Maze Shifters, after all. We have to go back together!
そうです。ここで自己犠牲ヒーローみたいな\nカッコイイマネはさせませんよ。そうい: Exactly. We won't let you play the cool self-sacrificing hero here. That kind of thing belongs strictly in stories.
もう……本当に仕方のない人達ですね……: Goodness... You all are truly helpless...
それに俺はさっき言ったはずだぞ。無事生還せよと。: Besides, I believe I told you earlier to survive and return safely.
そうでしたね……ですが、この状況からどうやって戻りますか？: That's true... But how do we get back in this situation?
誘導は解けたとはいえ、帰りもメイズシフターは多いはずだぞ。: Even though the guidance is broken, there should still be plenty of Maze Shifters on the way back.
まあ、そこは大丈夫だ。\nサイレンが解除になった以上、外も落ち着いてくるだろうし: Well, don't worry about that. Now that Siren is deactivated, things outside should start calming down, too.
お、来たか。レーダーにＭＧ反応多数。\n霞光のログで識別できる機体だ。つまり――: Oh, here they come. Multiple MG signatures on the radar. They match units identified in the Kako logs. Which means—
シリウスシュガー！ それにカオスメイデンも……！: Sirius Sugar! And Chaos Maiden, too...!
なんか地上の敵が急にやる気なくなって、どんどん逃げちゃってさ！\nそしたら生徒会: The enemies on the surface suddenly lost their spirit and started running away! Then the Student Council President told us to head to the Crystal Belt!
さあ、参りましょう。\n英雄の帰還です。胸を張ってくださいまし。: Now, let us go. It is the return of heroes. Please hold your heads up high.
